title: Beatrix and the Language
author: Dominic Underhill
blurb: Hazel Amberdale, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
